findings.title: The catalogues surface assigned to this lane is entirely absent from the round's ground-truth checkout
findings.description: This lane's brief and the round's task both name `/tmp/jl_XGd0LR/catalog` as the surface to audit — the hats, lanes, scans, models and seeds catalogues the engine reads at runtime (per `src/Scan.jl:80`, `src/CLI/Doctor.jl:250`, `src/CLI/Seed.jl`, `src/CLI/Init.jl:135`). No `catalog/` directory, nor any `scans.toml`, `hats/*.toml` or `seeds/*.toml` file, exists anywhere under the ground-truth root `/tmp/jl_XGd0LR` (confirmed by a full recursive listing and a repo-wide grep for 'catalog', which returns only the source code's own references to those paths, never the files themselves). `policy/RULES.toml` and `fixture/defects.toml` — the two files this lane's five per-row checks (rule-exists, fixture-class-exists, surfaces-name-real-keys, persona/substrate consistency, row contradiction) are supposed to be run against — are likewise absent from this checkout. None of the five per-row catalogue checks in the lane brief could be executed: there is no row to enumerate, so none of CORRECT/SELF-CONTAINED/NOTATION/FORMATTED/CURRENT/CITED could be verified on this surface either. Per this package's own RULE.TEST.MISSING_IS_FAILING ('a zero count is a dead lane rather than a clean one') and RULE.INST.SELF_REPORT ('a zero count is a dead lane rather than a clean hat'), this must be reported as a dead lane — unable to evaluate — never as a clean pass on the catalogues surface. Failure scenario: a consolidator or closure loop reading this lane's empty findings as 'catalogues surface clean' would bank the round as though every scan/hat/seed row were verified against RULES.toml and defects.toml, when the entire surface was never on disk to check — exactly the silent coverage hole the package's own dead-lane rule exists to prevent.
findings.resolution_hint: Fix the round/workflow snapshot step that assembles /tmp/jl_XGd0LR for the check-docs engine so it copies catalog/ (and, for this lane's cross-checks, policy/RULES.toml and fixture/defects.toml) alongside src/, ext/, docs/ and instruments/; then re-run this lane against the corrected snapshot before the round closes it as evaluated. Until re-run, record this lane in the round as 'cannot evaluate' rather than 'clean', consistent with RULE.TEST.MISSING_IS_FAILING.
